text:
ava: Heads up — customer tenant fail during SAML redirect. ACS returns 200 but session not persisted, user gets bounced to login loop. Cookies present but odd Path. Anyone seen ACS cookie Path set weirdly after the proxy bump?
ben: Can you paste the Set-Cookie header? might be a path/domain mismatch.
ava: Yep. header from prod before rollback: 
```
Set-Cookie: rw_session=eyJ...; Path=/quarantine; Domain=redwood.com; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None
```
carla: That Path=/quarantine is new — I think the proxy v2 landed a change that scopes cookies to the service route for isolation. It broke cross-subdomain SSO.
opsbot: deploy v2-proxy (canary) finished at 2024-10-12T18:22:01Z — commit f2a9b3c.
sanjay: Related symptoms: SCIM webhook from IdP occasionally failing to reconcile groups during the login flow. Checked audit logs and see KMS decrypt sporadic errors around the same times: 
```
2024-10-12T18:23:03Z scim: decrypt ext_id failed tenant=acme err="kms:InvalidCiphertext"
```
security-bot: RBAC audit shows partial provisioning: user created but role mapping skipped (scim patch returned 200 then 202 then eventually timeout). Correlation id: 3e4f2a.
ben: Two quick mitigations: 1) roll back cookie scoping (done?), or 2) add a fallback cookie with Path=/ at ACS that proxies set when they see the quarantined path. Also check SameSite and Domain.
ava: Rolled back proxy canary to previous config at 18:27Z, that stopped the login loop. Pushed a temporary ACS shim that sets cookie Path=/ as fallback. Pinging @eng-infra for root cause and long-term fix.
carla: We should add an e2e regression that asserts Set-Cookie path is compatible with cross-subdomain SSO (and a test for proxy config change detection).
sanjay: For KMS noise — looks like race where scim job retried with stale ciphertext during rewrap. Recommend adding retry with jitter and check rewrap lifecycle in kms-operator logs. I'll open a follow-up ticket to backfill orphan roles created during the window.
ava: Thanks all — assigning follow-ups: ENG-INFRA to audit proxy cookie scoping changes, ENG-SEC to validate RBAC audit alerts, and PLATFORM to patch KMS rewrap retry behavior. Closing this thread once infra confirms. :thumbsup:
